requirements.requirement: The system must render adjustable UI controls (e.g., sliders or numeric inputs) for each available evaluation measure.
The system must initialize all weight controls with default values provided by the backend or schema.
The system must allow users to modify weight values within defined valid ranges.
The system must prevent users from entering invalid weight values outside allowed constraints.
The system must trigger a recomputation request to the backend when a user changes any weight value.
The system must debounce rapid user input changes to avoid excessive API calls.
The system must display updated scores returned from the backend without requiring a full page refresh.
The system must show a loading indicator while recomputed scores are being fetched.
The system must maintain UI responsiveness while recomputation is in progress.
The system must display an error message if the recomputation API call fails.
The system must revert to the last known valid scores if recomputation fails.
The system must disable or visually indicate invalid inputs until corrected by the user.
The system must reflect the currently applied weights in the UI after each successful recomputation.
The system must handle the case where the backend returns partial or missing score data by displaying a fallback message instead of breaking the UI.
